presets.name: Pick keys
presets.summary: Keep only the keys you need from each object in a list.

presets.name: Rename keys
presets.summary: Give keys new names. A key written on its own keeps its name.

presets.name: Sort by
presets.summary: Sort a list of objects by one field. Add | reverse for highest first.

presets.name: Group and count
presets.summary: Group objects by a field and count each group.

presets.name: Unique by
presets.summary: Keep the first object for each value of a field, sorted by that field.

presets.name: Flatten
presets.summary: Turn a list of lists into one list.

presets.name: Merge objects
presets.summary: Merge a list of objects into one. Later values win, and nested objects merge too.

presets.name: Extract all values for a key
presets.summary: Find every value of a key, at any depth.

presets.name: Array of objects to CSV
presets.summary: One CSV line per object, with a header row from the first object's keys.
